description: Instance reuse on booking override: when user confirms override of a conflicting booking that has a running instance (status ready/deploying with instanceId), reuse the existing instance instead of terminating it. Invoke deployer Lambda to switch docker compose deployment.
steps: Modify lambda/api/handler.py create_booking() conflict handling to differentiate between reusable instances (have instanceId) and non-reusable (still polling/launching)
Add DEPLOYER_FUNCTION_NAME env var reading and _invoke_deployer helper to api/handler.py
Update CDK stack to pass DEPLOYER_FUNCTION_NAME env var to apiHandler and grant lambda:InvokeFunction permission on deployer
Update frontend BookingPage.tsx conflict modal to show different text based on whether the conflicting booking has an instanceId
Verify models.py supports instanceId/region/az in Booking constructor (already present)
acceptance_criteria: When override confirmed and conflicting booking has instanceId: instance is NOT terminated, new booking inherits instanceId/region/az, status set to deploying, deployer Lambda invoked
When override confirmed and conflicting booking has no instanceId: existing terminate behavior preserved
CDK synth succeeds with new env var and IAM permission
Frontend shows reuse message when conflicting booking has instanceId, terminate message otherwise
